title: Evaluation of generative imaging based on vital signs to potentially reduce the number of neonatal whole-body X-rays
summary: According to the study’s central hypothesis, images generated from vital signs data contain relevant structural and diagnostic information and show a statistically significant correlation with real whole-body/chest X-rays.
conditions: No specific clinical conditions are being investigated

interventions.name: The aim of the project is to investigate whether it is possible to generate synthetic full-body or chest X-ray images from vital signs data, the diagnostic quality of which is sufficient to replace or supplement X-rays that may not be strictly indicated in selected clinical situations.
